================================================================================
hash comment
================================================================================

# This is a comment
resource "aws_instance" "web" {
}

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

(config_file
  (comment)
  (resource_block
    type: (string_lit)
    name: (string_lit)
    body: (block_body)))

================================================================================
double slash comment
================================================================================

// This is a comment
resource "aws_instance" "web" {
}

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

(config_file
  (comment)
  (resource_block
    type: (string_lit)
    name: (string_lit)
    body: (block_body)))

================================================================================
block comment
================================================================================

/* This is a
   multi-line comment */
resource "aws_instance" "web" {
}

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

(config_file
  (comment)
  (resource_block
    type: (string_lit)
    name: (string_lit)
    body: (block_body)))

================================================================================
inline comment after attribute
================================================================================

resource "aws_instance" "web" {
  count = 1 # number of instances
}

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

(config_file
  (resource_block
    type: (string_lit)
    name: (string_lit)
    body: (block_body
      (attribute
        name: (identifier)
        value: (expression
          (literal_value
            (numeric_lit)))
        (comment)))))
